overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. Paper focuses on sign language translation evaluation with human baseline study. Key findings show 33.3% of sentences require discourse context for proper understanding. Human evaluation was conducted by fluent Deaf signer annotators. No LLMs were used in evaluation.
